query: What inference strategies (wild-cluster bootstrap, randomization inference, few-cluster corrections) perform best for panels dominated by a few large carriers?

response.query: What inference strategies (wild-cluster bootstrap, randomization inference, few-cluster corrections) perform best for panels dominated by a few large carriers?
response.answer: For panels dominated by a few large carriers, randomization inference often performs best compared to wild-cluster bootstrap and few-cluster corrections. This is due to its robustness in small cluster scenarios.

results.title: Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference for Few Treated Clusters
results.content: # Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference for Few Treated Clusters. Although procedures based on the wild cluster bootstrap often work well when the number of treated clusters is not too small, they can either over-reject or under- reject seriously when it is. In a previous paper, we showed that procedures based on randomization inference (RI) can work well in such cases. We propose a bootstrap-based alternative to randomization inference, which mitigates the discrete nature of RI P values in the few-clusters case.
